timing: Dataset-integrity corrections frozen before any extended-public retrieval scores were computed.

yo.reason: NoMIRACL relevant judgments contain foreign/mismatched document IDs and conflicting extra labels even where IDs collide with genuine Yoruba passages. Filling text or dropping missing IDs cannot safely repair judgments.
yo.impact: Exclude Yoruba from the primary independent held-out macro. Do not infer quality for Yoruba. Official TEST-B qrels are not publicly released separately, and initial NoMIRACL history contains the same defect. No replacement split is silently substituted.

zh.validation: After this mapping, all 393 NoMIRACL relevant-development query judgment dictionaries equal the pinned official MIRACL development dictionaries exactly. Reject conflicting canonical-ID labels and unknown missing-ID forms.
zh.textRecovery: Retain existing judged corpus text when present. Recover missing canonical passage IDs from the pinned official MIRACL corpus docs-0 shard, recording its upstream checksum and individual selected raw/canonical IDs. Preserve every label.

developmentCrosscheck.scope: Every NoMIRACL relevant development query in all 17 eligible languages compared against pinned official MIRACL development judgments, before retrieval scores.

completeEqualityExcept.difference: One extra explicit-negative NoMIRACL document ID 0; query is not selected by frozen sampling, so no benchmark effect.

developmentCrosscheck.strictRule: Every selected development query must equal official labels. Entire published development dictionaries must match except this single unselected, precisely checked extra-negative entry. Chinese canonicalization applies first.
